scripts.deploy: node scripts/build.mjs && wrangler pages deploy --branch main
scripts.deploy:worker: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/build-worker.mjs && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.worker.toml
scripts.dev:worker: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/build-worker.mjs && wrangler dev -c wrangler.worker.toml --port 8789
